articles.title: Gardeners set to lose 30-year-old community plot for Toronto supportive housing plead with city to save it
articles.summary: A 30-year-old community garden in downtown Toronto will soon have to pull up its stakes and move, as the city prepares to transform a piece of land into an eight-storey supportive housing project.

articles.title: Sept. 11 first responders to attend B.C. border ceremony on anniversary of attacks
articles.summary: SURREY — New York first responders on Sept. 11, 2001, are expected to be among the guests at a British Columbia memorial marking the 25th anniversary of the attacks.

articles.title: Trial remains elusive for purported mastermind accused of plotting 9/11 attacks
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — Two decades after U.S. authorities locked Khalid Sheikh Mohammed away at a military detention center in Cuba, the purported mastermind of the Sept. 11 attacks sometimes seems barely any closer to being put on trial than the day he arrived.

articles.title: Streaming fatigue? Inside the new Criterion retail store in Toronto
articles.summary: A massive selection of DVD, Blu-ray, and 4K physical movies lining every wall has opened in Toronto, curated by Criterion Collection, a film company based in New York. CBC’s Mercedes Gaztambide takes you inside its first retail store in the city.

articles.title: 2nd suspect arrested in 2022 murder of Ding Ping Wang, also charged in separate shooting
articles.summary: Toronto police say they’ve arrested a second suspect in the 2022 shooting death of Ding Ping Wang and have also charged him with attempted murder in a separate, non-fatal shooting months later. articles.title: Racing believed to be factor in deaths of 2 men in North York crash: police
articles.summary: Toronto police say they believe two men who died after their car struck a traffic light pole and knocked it down in North York were racing at the time.

articles.title: Durham police arrest 4, lay 229 charges after string of robberies, thefts, break-ins
articles.summary: Police say they have laid 229 charges against four people, including two youths, in connection with 36 smash-and-grab robberies, vehicle thefts and commercial break-in incidents in the Durham Region and Toronto.

articles.title: Brad Bradford says he will put a Toronto police outpost in Union Station if he’s elected mayor
articles.summary: Brad Bradford has promised a Toronto police outpost at Union Station as part of his mayoral campaign platform.
